sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.label: Bender and Pringle 1991
sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.actualReadDepth: Primary yeast genetic experiment; complete PubMed abstract read. Full scanned Methods and figures not acquired or read.
sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.supportsWithinScope: MSB1 function becomes conditionally essential in studied mutant backgrounds; plasmid/MSB1 restoration and temperature-dependent viability illustrate context and complementation. Abstract evidence is not a validated death assay or a literal cellular architecture.

sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.label: Sakai 2009
sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.actualReadDepth: Complete BioC XML acquired; complete abstract and selected Methods, Results and Figure 3–4 legend text read; figure images not acquired/read.
sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.supportsWithinScope: Restored BRCA2 function and re-depletion test causal contribution to drug sensitivity in selected experimental cell models. Drug sensitivity uses crystal-violet staining; the cartoon does not relabel it as validated death. The Figure 4 AG14361 result for one clone is not statistically significant; no uniform rescue effect or magnitude is inferred.

sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.label: Yadav 2015
sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.actualReadDepth: Complete BioC XML acquired; complete abstract, selected Introduction and Methods 2.1 text read; no source figure used.
sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.supportsWithinScope: Drug synergy is relative to a defined non-interaction model, dose pair and endpoint; growth inhibition and death are possible distinct endpoints. That score does not itself identify the causal paired biological functions.

sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.label: Bryant 2005
sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.actualReadDepth: Complete official PubMed abstract read. Publisher full-text access failed via cookie authorization; Methods and source figures not read.
sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.supportsWithinScope: A primary BRCA2/PARP model provides an experimental example of context-dependent vulnerability. No universal BRCA genotype forecast, physical PARP cartoon or clinical eligibility rule is derived.

sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.label: Hay 2005
sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.actualReadDepth: Complete official PubMed abstract read. Direct browser retrieval was recaptcha-gated; official EFetch XML succeeds. Methods and source figures not acquired/read.
sourceAccessShortAuthorProjection.supportsWithinScope: Brca2-deficient otherwise normal mouse intestinal tissue can be harmed in the studied PARP-inhibition experiment. This is a counterexample to assumed normal-cell safety; the abstract’s prophylactic speculation is not adopted.
